NORTH-WEST TERRITORIES
Papaschase   N. W. Ter                 694.00       2,642 50 4,705.83                ...

General Remarks.
The land sold during the year amounted to 17,758.56 acres, which realized $21,051 63. The quantity of surrendered
land in the hands of the department, in round numbers, is 457,929 acres. The total collections on account of old and
new sales, on rents and on timber, amounted to $134,174 23. The principal outstanding, on account of Indian lands,
amounted to $149,257.52, a considerable portion of which is not yet due.
J.D. McLEAN,
In charge of Land and Timber Branch.
HAYTER REED,
Deputy Supt. Gen. of Indian Affairs.

DEPARTMENT OF INDIAN AFFAIRS,
Ottawa, 30th June, 1896.
